one_liner.zh: 在 Web GUI 和命令行查看各 agent preset 的工具、MCP 与技能清单。
one_liner.en: Inspect each agent preset's tools, MCP servers, and skills in the Web GUI or CLI.

local: Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 compatible preset registry and Node.js >=22.
The dsh-presets CLI writes a composed-profile cache under DSH_HOME/cache.
The dsh-preset-plugin CLI can edit the selected profile's cordis.patch.yml and creates a backup.

config_items.name: DSH_HOME
config_items.description: Overrides the DSH home directory used by the host and CLI.
